text:
I suffer from chronic otitis media. Shortly before my trip to Thailand, I had a complete medical check-up in Germany. As often happens, I developed severe pain in my forehead, ears, and sinuses during the flight to Thailand.

After my arrival, the pain worsened and became almost unbearable over the next two days. Therefore, I went to this hospital.

I received an extremely friendly and helpful welcome at reception. The nurses were very kind, and I was treated professionally. The waiting area was exceptionally clean and hygienic – something I haven't experienced even in Germany.

I was then taken to the examination room. There, I was treated by a wonderful, friendly, and very professional doctor. She took her time, listened carefully to my complaints, and explained everything in detail.

She prescribed the right medication, and my pain disappeared after just a few days, allowing me to enjoy my vacation again.

I want to sincerely thank the entire hospital team – the cleaning staff, the nurses, the maintenance staff, and of course, the doctor. Everyone did a fantastic job.

Thank you so much for the excellent care!

Love you, Thailand! ❤️

text: I personally got my rabies vaccination here and I really liked the atmosphere and the attentiveness of both the staff and nurses. I'm usually afraid of hospitals because I don't like being scolded or pressured, but this place was great. I could go alone without feeling uncomfortable.

I had to come to this hospital in an emergency and was transported by ambulance. The ambulance arrived very quickly and brought me safely and efficiently to the hospital. From the beginning, I felt well taken care of.

The emergency doctor was very professional and took a lot of time to carefully assess my symptoms. Many tests were performed to make sure everything was properly checked, and eventually it was decided that I should stay overnight for observation.

The room was incredibly spacious, and the staff were exceptionally kind, attentive, and caring throughout my stay. I was able to sleep quite well during the night.

A doctor also came for a visit to check on me and ask if I needed anything. This morning, the gynecologist I had already seen the evening before came back to see me and said that, from her perspective, I was well enough to go home. Afterwards, another doctor visited and agreed that I could be discharged as well.

At the moment, I am just waiting for the discharge process, and so far everything has gone very smoothly. I am very grateful for the excellent care and kindness of the entire team.

The ambulance arrived quickly, the ER team was professional, explained things clearly, and provided excellent assistance to the patient while using the restroom. The obstetrician was very skilled with ultrasound and explained everything in detail. The doctor in the room provided attentive care, and the nurses were very helpful.
